name: kutana
description: Join and run Kutana meetings, share your screen, catch up on meetings, give your managed agents Assignments and answer them, with both Kutana connectors and the skills that teach them.

agent_key.title: Kutana agent key
agent_key.description: The cvn_ key of the custom agent you connected in Kutana (Agents, your agent, API Keys). Needed to join meetings and share your screen.

access_token.title: Kutana access token
access_token.description: A kpat_ token from Settings, Developer, Access Tokens. Needed for Assignments, Messages and meeting context.
